correctness.rationale: Over C and n>=9 odd congruent 1 mod 4, all three homogeneous forms of degree n+2 have no common zero, and the Galois subgroup argument proves birationality. All nontrivial deck coincidences reduce to (zeta+1)w^k+zeta*w-1=0. Its roots are simple because a double root would force |1+zeta|<(1/k), contrary to >=2/n>1/k. Two different zeta cannot share w since this forces w=-1 but k odd. Differentiated identity establishes transverse tangents. At infinity the local parametrization is (a^2 times a unit in a^2,a^n), analytically A_{n-1}; genus saturation proves completeness. The unique cusp forces affine normalization automorphisms; the embedding subspace W forces translation b=0 and scaling a^2=1. Source Lemma 5.1 then shows all ambient Cremona selfmaps are projective, so the full stabilizer is C2 and no odd-order deck map extends. Exact SymPy tests for n=9,13,17 supplement the uniform proof. Boundaries outside n>=9, n=1 mod 4 not asserted.

value.rationale: A natural generalization of a distinctive single cyclic-order-five counterexample gives explicit nonextendibility for infinitely many unbounded odd cyclic Galois orders. Beyond existence, it completely determines all singularity strata (large node set plus unique cusp) and the entire ambient stabilizer, turning the multiplicity rigidity mechanism into a structural infinite-series theorem. Root simplicity, no triple points, cusp analysis, and linear-series rigidity are meaningful uniform obstacles rather than routine tabulated parameter values.
